auditMethod: Read-only source-file inspection and SHA256 hashing; no CAD execution.
contentPolicy: Publish only original distilled methods and sanitized case summaries. Private source files and third-party PDFs are not redistributed, and no blanket license is asserted.
locatorPolicy: Source IDs resolve through a git-ignored local provenance map. Public descriptions are generic and are not paths to source files.
